x: This race constituted yet another new war-time promotion, and was held over a 5 miles course at Walthamstow. Jack Rutland walked a splendid race to finish 3rd, and J.
One of our Police walkers, Jim Watson, made a plucky first effort, but retired at 22 miles. Our sole competitor in the Reading "10" was Fred White, who ran well to finish 11th in 65m. 10s.

Harry Timberlake, although unable to take an active part in sport, is a very willing helper for the Club and for local youth atheltic organisations. Jim Watson was promoted to Inspector early in the year.

Doubleday and Jim Watson also finished, but were outside Time Standard. In the Polytechnic Marathon at Chiswick on 16th June, Doubleday was our only finisher in 3hrs. 18mins., Fred White having retired at 20 miles.

Fred White ran his best and finished eighteenth in 2 hours 58 minutes 50 seconds, Bert Mitchell twenty-seventh in 3 hours 7 minutes 0 seconds, Gordon Doubleday fifty-fourth in 3 hours 30 minutes 25 seconds, and Jim Watson sixty-fourth in 3 hours 41 minutes 37 seconds.
